baseline.cutoff_evidence: The LankaLaw page carries the enacting formula, s.1 'This Act may be cited as the Survey Act. No 17 of 2002', the head date '[ 4 th October , 2002 ]', no chain header and no inline marker. The Government Printer PDF is headed 'SURVEY ACT, No.17 OF 2002 [Certified on 04th October, 2002] Printed on the order of Government ... Published as a Supplement to Part II of the Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka of October 04, 2002'. Both are the Act as enacted; edition.kind is therefore as_enacted, not a consolidation.
